WebSearch_PluginDesc: Quickly initiate web searches using custom or built-in search engines (like Google, Baidu, GitHub, etc.) by typing specific trigger keywords directly in the search box.
WebSearch_PlaceholderDesc: Type keywords and press Enter to search
WebSearch_ResultDesc: Press Enter or click to open search results in your browser
WebSearch_Config_SourcesDesc: Configure custom search engines and keywords for web search.
WebSearch_Config_SuggestUrlDesc: Leave empty to disable suggestions for this engine. When set, up to 5 live suggestions are fetched as you type (OpenSearch JSON format).
WebSearch_SuggestionDesc: Suggested by {0} — press Enter or click to search
WebSearch_ProviderDesc: Triggers mainstream or custom web search engines quickly in the search box using keywords.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_WebSearchInstantProvide: Initiates real-time web searches using custom search engine keywords (like bd, gh) typed in the search box.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_WebSearchTranslationPro: Provides UI translations and localization resources for the Web Search plugin.
